Status:
1. Saved: Indicates that the shipment plan is in draft state and has been saved but not yet confirmed.
2. Confirmed: Indicates that the shipment plan has been finalized and the transaction is confirmed.
3. Closed: Indicates that the ASN (Advanced Shipment Notice) has been successfully created against the shipment plan.
4. Booked: Indicates that the PSN Invoice has been generated for the shipment plan, confirming booking completion.

Indicates that the PSN (Packing Slip Note) / Invoice has been generated for the shipment plan.

Indicates that the ASN (Advanced Shipment Notice) has been created against the shipment plan.
3. Sent to Finance
This status will be triggered as “Sent to FA” when the Shipping Bill reaches the confirmed state, covering both auto invoicing and manual invoicing scenarios.

chunks.title: Meeting Points:
chunks.heading: EXPORT LOGISTICS MANAGEMENT › Meeting Points:
chunks.text:
Buyer orders will be created in WFX
Shipment Plan will be created in WFX consisting of Sales Order Lines where shipment is due/ planned.
Shipment plan will be created on Customer PO (WFX delivery OC) level
Multiple OCs can be clubbed under one shipment plan
Pre-Shipment Sales Invoice (PSN) will be created based on shipment Plan created in previous stage.
Shipment plan list screen will have multiple status update will be provided (PSN created, ASN Created , Sent to FA, etc.)

chunks.title: Solution=> Shipment Plan
chunks.heading: EXPORT LOGISTICS MANAGEMENT › Solution=> Shipment Plan
chunks.text: Shipment plan will be created by selecting multiple delivery OCs as per user requirement:
chunks.locator: § EXPORT LOGISTICS MANAGEMENT › Solution=> Shipment Plan

chunks.title: Shahi Business Requirements
chunks.heading: EXPORT LOGISTICS MANAGEMENT › Shahi Business Requirements
chunks.text: The sales/ Production team will create a shipment plan that can include multiple deliveries and multiple destinations, grouped under a primary destination which will auto-populate in the Pre-Shipment Export Invoice/ Sales ASN but can be modified by the logistics team during ASN creation, where only a single destination will be selected. Multiple ASNs can be created under a single shipment plan. The shipment plan remains editable by the factory until the ASN is in the creation stage; however, once the Pre-Booking is done and ASN is completed, the shipment plan becomes locked. If any changes are made to the shipment plan, the system will trigger an email alert to the respective authorized personnel, which will act as an approval mechanism for revising either the shipment plan, PSN or the ASN. Upon such changes, the PSN/ ASN quantity will be updated based on the shipment plan (for example, reducing order quantity from 100 to 80). In the Sales ASN confirmed mode, a checkbox labeled “Applied for Booking” will be introduced; once selected, neither the shipment plan, PSN or ASN can be revised. This checkbox can only be unchecked by an authorized user based on existing permission controls, after which revisions to both ASN and shipment plan will be allowed. Additionally, once the shipment is confirmed and an e-way bill is generated, the ASN can be recreated only by cancelling the tax invoice and generating a new ASN with the existing data but a new ASN number, specifically in cases where shipment execution fails or requires correction. The shipment plan will also include a shipment tolerance percentage driven from the Buyer Master, which can vary across different Shahi divisions.
chunks.locator: § EXPORT LOGISTICS MANAGEMENT › Shahi Business Requirements

chunks.title: Status
chunks.heading: EXPORT LOGISTICS MANAGEMENT › Shipment Plan List › Status
chunks.text:
The Status column in the Shipment Plan List will represent the current stage of the shipment plan based on system transactions and document creation. The statuses are defined as follows:
• Saved: Indicates that the shipment plan is in draft state and has been saved but not yet confirmed.
• Confirmed: Indicates that the shipment plan has been finalized and the transaction is confirmed.
• Closed: Indicates that the ASN (Advanced Shipment Notice) has been successfully created against the shipment plan.
• Booked: Indicates that the PSN Invoice has been generated for the shipment plan, confirming booking completion.
chunks.locator: § EXPORT LOGISTICS MANAGEMENT › Shipment Plan List › Status

chunks.title: Progress Column
chunks.heading: EXPORT LOGISTICS MANAGEMENT › Shipment Plan List › Progress Column
chunks.text:
The Progress column will display the following stages:
• PSN Created
Indicates that the PSN (Packing Slip Note) / Invoice has been generated for the shipment plan.
• ASN Created
Indicates that the ASN (Advanced Shipment Notice) has been created against the shipment plan.
• Sent to Finance
This status will be triggered as “Sent to FA” when the Shipping Bill reaches the confirmed state, covering both auto invoicing and manual invoicing scenarios.
Shipment Plan list will have limited columns compared to Sales ASN.
Shipment plan will have 2 status “Confirmed” or “Closed”. Confirmed will be based on shipment plan created. Status will turn to “Closed” if ASN is created against “Shipment Plan” in Confirmed mode.
Revision of Shipment will be blocked if ASN is created in confirmed mode.
In case ASN is in Saved mode, then user will be able to revise Shipment Plan. However, while confirming ASN post revision system will show alert that Shipment plan has been revised.
In case user wants to revise a shipment plan where confirmed Sales ASN has already been created then user has to cancel the ASN or revise to keep in Saved mode.
